entry.author: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise
entry.summary:
Thinking about doing business in the UAE? 🇦🇪

This short guide will help New Zealand exporters and professionals understand the key cultural differences before entering the United Arab Emirates market.

The UAE is a relationship-driven business environment where trust, respect, and personal connections play a major role in decision-making. Meetings may feel more informal at first, but courtesy, patience, and cultural awareness are essential for building strong, lasting partnerships.

In this video, you’ll learn:

How respect, hospitality, and personal relationships influence business communication in the UAE

Why investing time in trust-building is crucial before discussing major deals

Practical tips for New Zealand businesses preparing to enter the UAE market

By understanding Emirati business culture, you’ll be better equipped to navigate social norms, avoid common pitfalls, and build successful long-term relationships in the region.

For more information, check out our UAE market guide here: https://my.nzte.govt.nz/collection/united-arab-emirates-market-guide
